name: Porcelain River
description: A river of smooth liquid porcelain winds through green hills, with painted ceramic fish and delicate bridges.
prompt: A single surreal landscape of a smooth river made of liquid white porcelain winding through green hills. Ceramic fish with painted blue patterns leap from the surface, delicate porcelain bridges cross the river, and trees have glazed ceramic leaves. Soft overcast light, elegant blue-and-white palette, dreamlike and refined, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: A river that flows like porcelain—beautiful, fragile, and full of painted fish. Would you cross?
